answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by locking tokens in a public bond that is slashed when an independent challenge proves duplicate identities coordinated to claim multiple rewards. A new account starts with little weight, so splitting one stake across a plume of identities does not multiply influence; each identity must fund its own bond and sustain its own history. Auditors can use nadir activity and basalt-like transaction records to trace linked claims. The attacker pays capital, fees, and time, and risks losing the bonds.
